role: supplementary robustness analysis; primary frozen benchmark remains unchanged

partition_policy.pima: five stratified train_test_split calls with seeds realization_seed through realization_seed + 4

primary_question: Are the qualitative generator rankings and dimension-level conclusions robust to independently shuffled train/test partition realizations?
seed_selection_note: Seed 2026 was the initial supplementary realization. Seed 3719704 was added as a further independent partition-realization sensitivity check. Neither realization replaces the frozen primary benchmark.
interpretation_boundary: Retraining stochastic generators can contribute residual run variation. These checks do not constitute a complete repeated-generator-seed experiment and are not pooled into a larger primary benchmark.
